result.title: HilbertGen-3D:Hilbert--Multifractal Conditioning for Topology-Aware 3D Generation
result.summary: High-fidelity 3D generative modeling underpins game asset creation, medical imaging, and VR/AR environmental design, where geometric structure directly influences perception and decision-making. Diffusion models represent a powerful paradigm for point cloud generation. However, existing approaches rely heavily on local voxel or patch features and often miss global structural organization, and much less work has studied how global conditioning can be used to improve generation quality. In this paper, we introduce HilbertGen-3D, a novel topology-aware conditional diffusion framework based on Hilbert-Multifractal Conditioning (HMC). HMC computes multi-scale voxel measures, serializes them via a 3D Hilbert curve to expose structured spatial dependencies, and estimates the generalized fractal dimensions from scale-dependent partition functions. We encode these signals as global embeddings and multi-scale tokens, and inject them into a diffusion denoiser through an efficient bottleneck fusion module. Across the Chair, Airplane, and Car categories of ShapeNet, our two conditioning variants reduce the absolute deviation of 1-Nearest Neighbor Accuracy (1-NNA) from 50% by up to 8.90 percentage points and increase coverage by up to 5.88 percentage points relative to TopoDiT-3D. This shows that combining local density cues with global Hilbert-multifractal structure provides a simple and effective recipe for high-fidelity and diverse 3D generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HilbertGen-3D，一种基于 Hilbert-多重分形条件（HMC）的条件扩散框架：计算多尺度体素测度、用 3D Hilbert 曲线序列化以显式化空间依赖、估计广义分形维数，并将这些信号作为全局嵌入与多尺度 token 经瓶颈融合注入去噪器，用于 ShapeNet 点云生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多尺度测度序列化 + 瓶颈融合的全局条件注入」可能可供核查全局几何结构如何进入并约束生成状态表示，与 LVR 关注的状态内结构组织、视觉细节保留有间接线索，但属 3D 生成任务，与 VLM 推理主线距离较远。
